topic: Onboarding setup for new team member
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on setting up an onboarding process for a new team member. [p1] requested that [me] conduct the onboarding, covering both database access and overall structure, suggesting multiple meetings over the next two days.

[me] confirmed availability to lead the onboarding but noted a prerequisite: someone needed to ensure VPN access was set up for the new hire first.
decisions: Onboarding sessions will cover databases and company structure.
action_items: [p1] or someone needs to arrange VPN setup for the new team member before onboarding can proceed.
